QUOTE: "Deny is the last gate. It is checked in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval. `check_approval` only consults the allow list."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in ServerManager::execute, but it also describes multiple other gates that block execution (hook, schema, tier, approval refusal), so it does not conclude that DENY is the only blocking list consulted there.
